name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clauses Existence(has_matching_key), Existence(target_door_open) and Existence(target_room_entered) are redundant. In a hard ordered sequence the only required hard goal is the final step (picking up the ball); the earlier steps are already forced by the later hard Existence clauses together with the Precedence chain. Therefore the three early Existence clauses should be removed, keeping the Precedence clauses and the final Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: Eventually pick up the target ball
Pick up the target ball only after entering the target room
Enter the target room only after the target door has been opened
Open the target door only after having the matching key
Pick up the matching key only after the key has been found
